item.title: I am happier writing code by hand
item.description:
📝 Vibe coding interfered with that. By design, vibe coding has an addictive nature to it, you write some instructions, and code that looks correct is generated. If the code isn’t correct, then it’s just one prompt away from being correct, right.
🔗 Read more: https://www.abhinavomprakash.com/posts/i-am-happier-writing-code-by-hand/

item.title: AI fatigue Is real and nobody talks about it
item.description:
📝 Not from writing code - from judging code. The cruel irony is that AI-generated code requires more careful review than human-written code. And reading code you didn't write, that was generated by a system that doesn't understand your codebase's history or your team's conventions, is exhausting work.
🔗 Read more: https://siddhantkhare.com/writing/ai-fatigue-is-real

item.title: The Contagious Taste of Cancer
item.description:
📝 History Matters The Contagious Taste of Cancer Early modern cancer experiments such as that undertaken by English surgeon Samuel Smith privileged the senses, but the effects could be fatal. Rather than suggesting that he contracted cancer from ingesting anything, it was the ‘sensory’ experience that caused his eventual death. During plagues, commentators often reported that sights, smells, and sounds associated with disease caused such intense fear that the observer’s body could become more vulnerable.
🔗 Read more: https://www.historytoday.com/archive/history-matters/contagious-taste-cancer
